fields.label: Excess Leave Notification Roles
Leave Types for Accrual & Carry Forward
fields.description: Select leave types that should follow the monthly accrual and carry-forward rules. Each selected Leave Type must have Accrual Rules configured under Leave Type > Custom Annual Leave Accrual Rules. The system will automatically allocate leaves on the employee's joining anniversary and carry forward unused balance at year-end.

fields.label: Leave Types Requiring 1-Year Service
fields.description: Select leave types that require employees to complete at least 1 year of service before they can apply. When an employee applies for any of these leave types before completing 1 year, a warning will be shown with their current accrued balance.

fields.label: Paternity Leave Type
fields.description: Select the leave type used for Paid Paternity Leave validation. The system will check that the child's date of birth is within the allowed period when this leave type is selected.

fields.label: Paternity Leave Eligibility Period (Months)
fields.description: Number of months after the child's date of birth within which Paid Paternity Leave must be taken. Default is 6 months.

fields.label: Hajj/Umrah Leave Type
fields.description: Select the leave type used for Hajj/Umrah Leave validation. The system will enforce religion eligibility, max days, and one-time-only rules for this leave type.

fields.label: Eligible Religions for Hajj/Umrah
fields.description: Comma-separated list of religions eligible for Hajj/Umrah Leave. Default is 'Muslim'. Employees with other religions will not be allowed to apply.

fields.label: Allow Hajj/Umrah Leave Only Once
fields.description: When enabled, employees can only avail Hajj/Umrah Leave once during their entire employment period.
